roles.finding: Prefix completion residual equality is exactly new-band twin equality for the fixed split, but full U_n types require accumulated old-band accounting.
roles.recommendation: Prove length/equality cases and old/new support separation before any type count.

roles.finding: C013/C042 exact quotienting is a same-domain transformation with aligned polarity; Myhill-Nerode terminology supplies classification only, not asymptotic or cover lower-bound authority.
roles.recommendation: Use SEARCH with a complete C013 mapping and keep communication/automata analogies nonauthoritative.

roles.finding: The cheapest killers are no new UNSAT parameter pair, unexpected residual equality/inequality, collision with an old star, or a small type-class upper bound.
roles.recommendation: Freeze exact symbolic residual branches and do not run an LP.

roles.finding: A finite executable can corroborate word/type lists, but proof requires the length formula, clause classification, residual set identities and exact support arguments.
roles.recommendation: Treat computation as receipt generation only and bind explicit witnesses.

roles.finding: Finite residual equivalence and type-class rectangles are elementary; value is diagnostic unless a uniform later growth theorem is proved.
roles.recommendation: Make no novelty claim and retain later-level uncertainty.

disagreement: The domain lens permits a finite row-splitting checkpoint; the adversarial lens predicts it may still be killed by constant type count or multiplexing. Both select the cheap exact quotient screen.
strongest_objection: Even exact growth in the number of residual classes is not a lower bound on rho and cannot be promoted to recurrence or circuit hardness.

mathematical_lesson_boundary.rule: Assurance is necessary but has zero mathematical saturation credit.

recommendation: After the new semantic-shortcut gate passes, freeze one bounded symbolic first-row-split discriminator; no LP, lower-bound candidate or decoder mutation.
